title: Gaussian Grouping: Segment and Edit Anything in 3D Scenes

expected_findings.main_contribution: extend Gaussian Splatting to jointly reconstruct and segment anything in open-world 3D scenes by augmenting each Gaussian with a compact Identity Encoding
expected_findings.key_improvement: discrete and grouped 3D Gaussians can reconstruct, segment and edit anything in 3D with high visual quality, fine granularity and efficiency
expected_findings.supervision: 2D mask predictions by Segment Anything Model plus 3D spatial consistency regularization, without expensive 3D labels
